subject: Plot dif item on one dimension

messages.author: f61de5f78c7e0a18
messages.subject: Plot dif item on one dimension
parts:
Dear Phil,

I am examining a 20 dichotomous item questionnaire. Preliminary analysis clearly showed two dimensions.  DIF analysis showed that an item functions differently across gender. Is it possible to plot ICC for the dif item on one only dimension holding the second dimension constant?

Thanks a lot,

Nikos

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Plot dif item on one dimension
parts:
Hi Nikos,

With two-dimensions you still should be able to use surface plots provided by the package to demonstrate this effect. Either use plot() or itemplot(), supplying the model containing the modeled DIF effect, and inspect the respective curves to evaluate the magnitude of the surface differences. It might require some rotation to see things best (or better yet, the use of the rgl package....). HTH.

Phil
